name: HelloBench
description: A comprehensive benchmark to evaluate large language models' long text generation capabilities across five subtasks based on Bloom's Taxonomy, including open-ended QA, summarization, chat, text completion, and heuristic text generation, with a novel human-aligned evaluation method called HelloEval.
reputation: A recent research benchmark from the paper introducing HelloEval; it is not yet widely established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on long text generation; introduces HelloEval, a human-aligned evaluation method with high correlation to human judgment; covers multiple generation subtasks.
